list.name: session
list.label: Session
list.query: SELECT __text, __value FROM (SELECT 'Aktuelle Session' AS __text, 'current' AS __value, 0 AS sort, now() AS created UNION ALL SELECT to_char(s."CreatedAtUtc", 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') || ' | ' || left(s."SessionId"::text, 8), s."SessionId"::text, 1, s."CreatedAtUtc" FROM optimizer_sessions s) sessions ORDER BY sort, created DESC

panels.title: Letzter berechneter PV-Überschuss
panels.description: max(PV verfügbar - Verbrauch laut Optimierer, 0) aus dem letzten run der gewählten Session. Kein gemessener Netzexport.

targets.rawSql: SELECT GREATEST(r."AvailablePvPowerWatt" - r."ConsumedPowerWatt", 0) AS "Überschuss (W)" FROM optimizer_requests r WHERE r."SessionId" = COALESCE(NULLIF(${session:sqlstring}, 'current')::uuid, (SELECT s."SessionId" FROM optimizer_sessions s WHERE s."EndedAtUtc" IS NULL ORDER BY s."CreatedAtUtc" DESC LIMIT 1)) AND r."RequestType" = 'run' ORDER BY r."RequestTimestamp" DESC, r."Id" DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT r."AvailablePvPowerWatt" AS "PV (W)" FROM optimizer_requests r WHERE r."SessionId" = COALESCE(NULLIF(${session:sqlstring}, 'current')::uuid, (SELECT s."SessionId" FROM optimizer_sessions s WHERE s."EndedAtUtc" IS NULL ORDER BY s."CreatedAtUtc" DESC LIMIT 1)) AND r."RequestType" = 'run' ORDER BY r."RequestTimestamp" DESC, r."Id" DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Letzte Soll-EIN-Entscheidungen
panels.description: Anzahl der Kunden mit ShouldSwitch = true im letzten run; kein gemessener Schaltzustand.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE u."ShouldSwitch" IS TRUE) AS "Soll EIN" FROM optimizer_requests r JOIN optimizer_request_users u ON u."RequestEntryId" = r."Id" WHERE r."Id" = (SELECT last_run."Id" FROM optimizer_requests last_run WHERE last_run."SessionId" = COALESCE(NULLIF(${session:sqlstring}, 'current')::uuid, (SELECT s."SessionId" FROM optimizer_sessions s WHERE s."EndedAtUtc" IS NULL ORDER BY s."CreatedAtUtc" DESC LIMIT 1)) AND last_run."RequestType" = 'run' ORDER BY last_run."RequestTimestamp" DESC, last_run."Id" DESC LIMIT 1)

panels.title: Letzte Messung Richtung DLS
panels.description: Letzter DirectLinePower-Messwert innerhalb der Session; das Vorzeichen wird unverändert angezeigt.

targets.rawSql: SELECT f."Value" AS "DLS (W)" FROM optimizer_field_data f JOIN optimizer_sessions s ON s."SessionId" = COALESCE(NULLIF(${session:sqlstring}, 'current')::uuid, (SELECT active."SessionId" FROM optimizer_sessions active WHERE active."EndedAtUtc" IS NULL ORDER BY active."CreatedAtUtc" DESC LIMIT 1)) WHERE f."Type" = 'DirectLinePower' AND f."Variable" = 'PowerWatt' AND f."Timestamp" >= s."CreatedAtUtc" AND (s."EndedAtUtc" IS NULL OR f."Timestamp" <= s."EndedAtUtc") ORDER BY f."Timestamp" DESC, f."Id" DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: PV, Bedarf, Verbrauch und berechneter Überschuss
panels.description: Nur run-Ereignisse. Überschuss = max(PV verfügbar - Verbrauch laut Optimierer, 0); fehlende Werte werden nicht als null Watt interpretiert.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__time(r."RequestTimestamp"), r."AvailablePvPowerWatt" AS "PV verfügbar", r."ConsumedPowerWatt" AS "Verbrauch (Optimierer)", r."TotalRequiredPowerWatt" AS "Bedarf", GREATEST(r."AvailablePvPowerWatt" - r."ConsumedPowerWatt", 0) AS "Überschuss (berechnet)" FROM optimizer_requests r WHERE r."RequestType" = 'run' AND r."SessionId" = COALESCE(NULLIF(${session:sqlstring}, 'current')::uuid, (SELECT s."SessionId" FROM optimizer_sessions s WHERE s."EndedAtUtc" IS NULL ORDER BY s."CreatedAtUtc" DESC LIMIT 1)) AND $__timeFilter(r."RequestTimestamp") ORDER BY 1, r."Id"

panels.title: Soll-Schaltzustand je Kunde
panels.description: ShouldSwitch aus run-Ereignissen: 1 = Optimierer empfiehlt EIN, 0 = AUS. Kein physisch gemessener Kontakt. Lücken zwischen run-Ereignissen werden nicht als neue Messung interpretiert.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__time(r."RequestTimestamp"), c."Name" || ' (' || COALESCE(c."CustomerNumber", c."Id"::text) || ')' AS metric, CASE WHEN u."ShouldSwitch" THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS value FROM optimizer_requests r JOIN optimizer_request_users u ON u."RequestEntryId" = r."Id" JOIN customers c ON c."Id" = u."CustomerId" WHERE r."RequestType" = 'run' AND u."ShouldSwitch" IS NOT NULL AND r."SessionId" = COALESCE(NULLIF(${session:sqlstring}, 'current')::uuid, (SELECT s."SessionId" FROM optimizer_sessions s WHERE s."EndedAtUtc" IS NULL ORDER BY s."CreatedAtUtc" DESC LIMIT 1)) AND $__timeFilter(r."RequestTimestamp") ORDER BY 1, r."Id", c."Id"

SELECT $__time(f."Timestamp"), f."Station" AS metric, f."Value" AS value FROM optimizer_field_data f JOIN optimizer_sessions s ON s."SessionId" = COALESCE(NULLIF(${session:sqlstring}, 'current')::uuid, (SELECT active."SessionId" FROM optimizer_sessions active WHERE active."EndedAtUtc" IS NULL ORDER BY active."CreatedAtUtc" DESC LIMIT 1)) WHERE f."Type" = 'PvYield' AND f."Variable" = 'PowerWatt' AND f."Timestamp" >= s."CreatedAtUtc" AND (s."EndedAtUtc" IS NULL OR f."Timestamp" <= s."EndedAtUtc") AND $__timeFilter(f."Timestamp") ORDER BY 1, f."Id"

SELECT $__time(f."Timestamp"), f."Station" AS metric, f."Value" AS value FROM optimizer_field_data f JOIN optimizer_sessions s ON s."SessionId" = COALESCE(NULLIF(${session:sqlstring}, 'current')::uuid, (SELECT active."SessionId" FROM optimizer_sessions active WHERE active."EndedAtUtc" IS NULL ORDER BY active."CreatedAtUtc" DESC LIMIT 1)) WHERE f."Type" = 'StationConsumption' AND f."Variable" = 'PowerWatt' AND f."Timestamp" >= s."CreatedAtUtc" AND (s."EndedAtUtc" IS NULL OR f."Timestamp" <= s."EndedAtUtc") AND $__timeFilter(f."Timestamp") ORDER BY 1, f."Id"

panels.title: Richtung DLS (gemessene Leistung)
panels.description: Vorzeichen und Einheit entsprechen dem gesendeten PowerWatt-Messwert.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__time(f."Timestamp"), f."Station" AS metric, f."Value" AS value FROM optimizer_field_data f JOIN optimizer_sessions s ON s."SessionId" = COALESCE(NULLIF(${session:sqlstring}, 'current')::uuid, (SELECT active."SessionId" FROM optimizer_sessions active WHERE active."EndedAtUtc" IS NULL ORDER BY active."CreatedAtUtc" DESC LIMIT 1)) WHERE f."Type" = 'DirectLinePower' AND f."Variable" = 'PowerWatt' AND f."Timestamp" >= s."CreatedAtUtc" AND (s."EndedAtUtc" IS NULL OR f."Timestamp" <= s."EndedAtUtc") AND $__timeFilter(f."Timestamp") ORDER BY 1, f."Id"

panels.title: Benötigte Leistung je Kunde (Optimierer)
panels.description: RequiredPowerWatt je Kunde aus run-Ereignissen. Angeforderte Leistung, unabhängig von der Soll-Schaltentscheidung.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__time(r."RequestTimestamp"), c."Name" || ' (' || COALESCE(c."CustomerNumber", c."Id"::text) || ')' AS metric, u."RequiredPowerWatt" AS value FROM optimizer_requests r JOIN optimizer_request_users u ON u."RequestEntryId" = r."Id" JOIN customers c ON c."Id" = u."CustomerId" WHERE r."RequestType" = 'run' AND r."SessionId" = COALESCE(NULLIF(${session:sqlstring}, 'current')::uuid, (SELECT s."SessionId" FROM optimizer_sessions s WHERE s."EndedAtUtc" IS NULL ORDER BY s."CreatedAtUtc" DESC LIMIT 1)) AND $__timeFilter(r."RequestTimestamp") ORDER BY 1, r."Id", c."Id"

panels.title: Letzter Lauf: Bedarf und Soll-Schaltzustand je Kunde
panels.description: Benötigte Leistung und Entscheidung aus demselben letzten run der gewählten Session; kein gemessener Schaltkontakt.

targets.rawSql: SELECT c."Name" || ' (' || COALESCE(c."CustomerNumber", c."Id"::text) || ')' AS "Kunde", u."RequiredPowerWatt" AS "Benötigt (W)", CASE WHEN u."ShouldSwitch" THEN 'EIN' ELSE 'AUS' END AS "Soll" FROM optimizer_requests r JOIN optimizer_request_users u ON u."RequestEntryId" = r."Id" JOIN customers c ON c."Id" = u."CustomerId" WHERE r."Id" = (SELECT last_run."Id" FROM optimizer_requests last_run WHERE last_run."SessionId" = COALESCE(NULLIF(${session:sqlstring}, 'current')::uuid, (SELECT s."SessionId" FROM optimizer_sessions s WHERE s."EndedAtUtc" IS NULL ORDER BY s."CreatedAtUtc" DESC LIMIT 1)) AND last_run."RequestType" = 'run' ORDER BY last_run."RequestTimestamp" DESC, last_run."Id" DESC LIMIT 1) ORDER BY u."UserIndex"
